mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month prior to the prediction is associated with tightened financial conditions, which reduces risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite FEDFUNDS > 4% for ≥2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) while UNRATE falls indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and supports positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of similar labor strength regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) below the prior quarter's average predicts a demand shortfall, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during contraction periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 105 signals supply-side weakness, which raises uncertainty and produces negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >40% of INDPRO < 105 events.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in a single month, it reflects accelerating inflation expectations, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during such CPI movements.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% over two consecutive months suggests weaker wage growth, which reduces equity risk premia and supports positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive in >70% of similar UNRATE decline episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both PAYEMS and GDPC1 (retail and business demand) above historical averages for the prior quarter predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative despite both proxies above quarterly averages.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls by more than 10% from the prior quarter, it signals weak consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such events.
